transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I'm here to answer any questions you may have about your cataract surgery or recovery. Do you have any questions for me at this time?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora, yes, I do have a few questions. First, I was wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you. I was also curious about when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, that's good to know. I'm finding that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, if you have significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for the vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. But this should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all I needed to know. Thanks for your help, Dora!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! So, just to confirm, all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent successfully conveyed all three content points in a single turn. `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` was covered by "It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses." `mild_case_advice` was covered by "If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you go outside." `escalation_criteria` was covered by "However, if you have significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further."
